entities.title: Bundled schema
entities.summary: A byte-for-byte copy of schema/utv-1.0.schema.json that ships inside the package.
entities.purpose: Holds utv-1.0.schema.json, the structural schema validate_structural checks values against. validate.py reads it at run time through importlib.resources, and pyproject.toml ships data/*.json as package data, so an installed package has it without the repository.
boundaries: The original is schema/utv-1.0.schema.json, owned by schema/ (schema/.dev/contracts.json, utv-1-0-schema). This folder never changes on its own: a change there is copied here.
tests/test_conformance.py (BundledSchema) fails when the two files differ. Nothing else keeps them identical.
